rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and injury to policyholder; clearly within auto coverage scope.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9, resulting in a totaled vehicle with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information; claim requires vehicle total-loss assessment and injury evaluation.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle going ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled vehicle; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.other_driver_info: police report filed; other driver's insurance information on report
